policy: source/path/verification requirements; status is evidence-qualified, not an assertion of release completion

requirements.assertion: Zoom +/- updates only recipe.viewZoom (10% increments) and does not regenerate stripe stations; framing persists in serialized recipe and PNG output.
Nudge changes recipe.positionX/positionY by one step; it is composition movement, NOT viewport-only pan; lock position suppresses changes.
Any new viewport-only Pan must be explicitly implemented with separate state, defined export/serialization semantics, tests and labels before enabling; not an alias for nudge.
Fit button (new) resets viewZoom=1 without touching any other recipe fields, retains canvas overflow extrapolation and full resolution export.
requirements.status: implemented in PR #79; browser acceptance qualification pending

requirements.assertion: Exact original SVG brand icon remains beside name; theme dots remain cream/black with thin black borders.
Edit destination uses actual approved-family adjustments glyph; Draw uses original pencil/path. No generic pictogram substitutions.
requirements.status: Edit symbol reassigned in PR #79; other new icons staged without UI wiring

requirements.assertion: Current six dock actions and separate edit rail remain reachable; five-destination navigation proposal must preserve Randomize, Save and direct Download.
requirements.status: current implementation verified / new shell proposed

requirements.assertion: All 7 categories, 40 tools and 87 static configuration data-setting keys retain functioning source form controls, including conditional applicability.
requirements.status: source inventory confirmed; runtime coverage partial

requirements.assertion: Dynamic element stacks, types, position, style and seven colour targets remain editable; UI generated at runtime.
Draw, interpretive 1x–10x smooth, add/delete/corner anchors, resmooth, undo and path extension are preserved.
requirements.status: source-confirmed with unit coverage, browser coverage partial

requirements.assertion: Three material layers and all six layer/finish cards, rotation steppers and disabled layer states remain available; no collision.
No duplicate ROYGBIV slider colour in same active card; blue eligible and assignments stable during editing.
Search exposes exact tool and can close; free scroll doesn't reset; history returns to tool without loss.
Explore, saved favourites and edit-history are distinct; gallery restore is a deliberate recipe action.
PNG export and embedded metadata, JSON recipe, share link, seed, import, batch generation and notifications remain reachable.
No actionable clipping or preview/editor overlap at 412x892 and 499/500/790/791, short landscape, disabled/focus states.
requirements.status: partial automated coverage; physical Chrome unverified

requirements.assertion: One focused slider may be tested as opt-in; multi-slider view remains default; switching parameters never resets other values.
